appDescription: TR-0086 deployment option D, the consumer side: finds its MN-CSE through MEC 011 service discovery (the service named in appServiceRequired, at a CSEBase named onem2m.edgeCse), accepts it only if the IN-CSE holds a <remoteCSE> for the CSE-ID it answers with (the two reads of estimed/handover.py registered_mn), and runs the sensor AE on it. onem2m.mnCse names that IN-CSE (cse-in): the platform's address for it is the one CSE address the consumer takes from the platform; the MN-CSE's address comes from MEC 011 only. Open: MEC 011 registration is unauthenticated, so a second onem2m-mn-cse service blocks discovery (refused, not resolved), and a stray answering with a CSE-ID the IN holds passes the check (it does not compare the <remoteCSE>'s poa with the endpoint). sensor_ae.py is a byte-for-byte copy of estimed/apps/sensor_ae/sensor_ae.py.
